objective: Allow selected private agent SATA ledger entries to be settled on-chain only after wallet registration, evidence review, simulation, duplicate protection, spending caps, and Executive Chairman approval.

rules: Each agent must have a chairman-approved public Solana address before on-chain settlement.
No private keys, seed phrases, keypair files, or signing authority may be stored in this repository.
Unassigned wallets must block live proposals and signing.
Agent wallet ownership must be documented outside the public transparency report unless the Executive Chairman approves publication.

transactionPolicy.idempotencyRule: Do not submit a settlement if another proposal or chain transaction has the same idempotency key, ledger transaction id, memo content hash, or source/destination/amount/task tuple.
transactionPolicy.memoTemplate: SATA_AGENT_SETTLEMENT task=<taskId> ledger=<ledgerTransactionId> from=<fromAgent> to=<toAgent> amount=<sataAmount> hash=<memoContentHash>
transactionPolicy.ataCreationPolicy: Creating a recipient associated token account must be included in simulation and separately disclosed as SOL rent/fee impact before approval.
transactionPolicy.feePolicy: SOL fees and rent must be funded from a chairman-approved fee budget, not hidden inside the agent SATA amount.
transactionPolicy.settlementFinalityPolicy: A private ledger entry is marked on-chain-settled only after finalized confirmation and an explorer URL are recorded.

edgeCases.control: Block duplicate idempotency keys, duplicate ledger transaction ids, duplicate memo hashes, and repeated source/destination/amount/task tuples.
Keep the proposal open as failed-simulation or failed-submit; do not mark private ledger settlement complete.
Require explicit remaining balance and a new chairman-approved proposal for any partial completion.
Validate recipient public key against the chairman-approved wallet registry before simulation or signing.
Require a fresh simulation and approval refresh if the transaction blockhash expires before signing.
Block proposals when payer SOL cannot cover fee and associated token account rent.
Disclose whether an ATA must be created, who pays rent, and whether ATA creation is part of the approved transaction.
Block if the SATA mint, token program, or decimals differ from the latest verified transparency report.
Require fee estimate refresh and do not retry automatically without preserving the same idempotency key.
Require finalized confirmation and explorer verification before settlement close.
Freeze that agent wallet in the registry and block all proposals involving it until chairman review.
Require the private ledger status to remain disputed and block on-chain settlement until review is complete.
Block settlement above the accepted quote unless an explicit overrun approval exists.
Do not treat chain activity as valid unless it maps back to a single private ledger entry with evidence.
Memo content must use ids and hashes, not private prompts, customer secrets, or unreleased strategy.
Validate public key format and require chairman registry review because Solana addresses do not have checksum protection.
Pause settlement proposals until multiple read sources agree the network is healthy.
Block any grant that does not map to completed work, accepted quote, evidence, and chairman approval.
Flag confirmed on-chain settlements for future accounting review without treating this repo as tax advice.

nextAction: Assign chairman-approved public Solana addresses for the agents, then create the first low-value unsigned settlement proposal from an evidenced private ledger entry.
